rows.en:
(Phew, I somehow got through today's
EX-Gear training.)
Hm, Alto? What's up?

You were in pretty good form in that class
just now!

Oh, was I?
I was just flying like I always do...

Hmm, I see...
Well, you could say flying naturally
is what matters most.
Yeah, maybe you're right.
Well, keep it up like this next time too!
(Was that... Alto complimenting me...?)

(Phew, today's EX-Gear training
is finally over.)
Hm, Saotome-kun? What's up?

Huh, really?
I was just flying like I always do...
Maybe you're right.
(Was that... Saotome-kun complimenting me...?)

(Well, that's another week done.
What should I do this weekend...)

(Oh, there's Alto.
Maybe I'll ask how he spends his weekends.)
Hey, Alto. Got a sec?

Hm, \p.
What is it?

Nah, I was just wondering what you're doing
this weekend, Alto...
The weekend, huh... Right, it's almost here.
rows.notes: x2, Alto, both genders; 'soiya sou datta na' (he had forgotten).

rows.en: Got any plans...?

Not really.
Once I start on the housework,
the time's gone before I know it...
rows.notes: x2, Alto, both genders; ie no koto = chores at home.

rows.en: Housework...?
Yeah. Cooking especially takes a while.
I see. Sounds like a quiet weekend.
Well, I guess you could say that.
(Alto's surprisingly domestic...)

(Well, that's another week done.
What should I do this weekend...)

(Oh, Saotome-kun.
Maybe I'll ask how he spends his weekends.)
Hey, Saotome-kun. Do you have a moment?

Oh, I was just wondering what you're doing
this weekend, Saotome-kun...
Any plans or anything...?
Housework...?
Huh~, sounds like a pretty quiet weekend.
(Saotome-kun's surprisingly domestic...)
(Today's PE class... is kinda rough...)

\p, what's wrong?
You're moving kind of slow.
rows.notes: x4: Alto (both genders), then repeated later in the scene under no name plate (PLAYER/none); the \p shows it is Alto's line again, so it reads fine both times.

rows.en:
Oh, Alto...
I mean, isn't today's class kinda brutal?
Is it? I don't really feel it...

Hmm, figures, Alto. Is that from all your
training as an actor?
Don't talk nonsense. Come on, keep at it!
Yeah, yeah...
(Alto may not look it, but he's got stamina...)
(Today's PE class... might be kinda rough...)

Oh, Saotome-kun...
I mean, isn't today's class kinda brutal?

Hmm, figures, Saotome-kun. That's from all
your training as an actor, right?
Okaaay...

(Saotome-kun may not look it, but he's got
stamina...)

(I came into town with no real plan...
What should I do...)
(Huh? It's Alto. What's he up to...?)

Hey, Alto, fancy running into you.
What are you up to?

Oh, it's you, \p.
What about you? What are you doing here?
Huh?! Answering a question with a question...

...Yeah, fair point. Sorry.
The weather was nice, so I figured I'd come
into town for once...
I see. So you're in the same boat as me.

Hm, so you're the same, \p?
What a pair we are.
rows.notes: x2, Alto, both genders; 'sewa nai na'.

rows.en: Yeah, really.
(In the end, I spent a lazy day with Alto...)

(I came into town with no real plan...
What should I do...)
(Huh? It's Saotome-kun. What's he up to...?)

Um, Saotome-kun, fancy running into you.
What were you doing?
I see. So you're in the same boat as me.

(In the end, I spent a lazy day
with Saotome-kun...)

uncertain: c15682: shared by Alto and a later no-plate repeat in nml_alt_010 (both genders); it contains \p, so the repeat must be Alto (or someone else) addressing the player again, not the player. Translated as Alto's line.
c15701: 'sewa nai na' rendered 'What a pair we are.' (wry: both came out with no plan).
